entities.title: Transit visa for Germany
entities.summary: Pakistani nationals may require a visa for the international transit area of a German airport. The transit visa allows stay within the transit area of a German airport.
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visa
FRC (Family Registration Certificate), Marriage Certificate (if applicable), Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
application_process: Fill out the Videx visa application form online and print it
important_notes: No airport transit visa is required for holders of diplomatic passports, family members of an EU or UK citizen, or people who hold a residence permit or visa of a Schengen state, a non-Schengen EU state, Andorra, Canada, Japan, San Marino, the United Kingdom, the United States of America, or a Dutch Overseas Territory.
